visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a blurred view of a FamilyMart storefront. Bold text overlays in green and white announce a tour of recent new products in Japanese convenience stores. Icons for FamilyMart, 7-Eleven, and Lawson appear at the bottom center to represent the stores included in the compilation. (2) A hand holds a green Häagen-Dazs Matcha Berry ice cream box against the backdrop of a FamilyMart entrance. A male customer in a white shirt walks through the glass doors in the background. The shot cuts to the ice cream bar, showing a green wafer and a bite revealing light green tea ice cream with a vibrant red berry filling inside. (3) The scene shifts to a hand holding a white and pink cup of Akagi Tabe-ru Bokujo Momo (Peach Milk Ice Cream). The cup features a cute cartoon girl character on the lid. The background shows blurred freezer shelves. The hand rotates the cup to display the side label with Japanese text. (4) Inside a Lawson store, a hand presents a yellow box of Meiji Kinoko no Yama (Mushroom Mountain) cheese flavor. The packaging shows a cheerful cartoon character and mushroom-shaped snacks. Various other snack boxes are visible on the surrounding retail shelves under bright, flat commercial lighting. (5) A hand holds a round, black and yellow bowl of Acecook 'Infinite Wakame' Mazesoba instant noodles. The packaging features large Japanese characters and a picture of the noodles. The background remains a convenience store aisle with typical bright lighting. (6) The video transitions to 7-Eleven, showing a red package of Fujiya Black Milky cola-flavored candies. The iconic Peko-chan character is visible on the front. A hand holds the bag steadily while variety-style captions provide details about the 75th-anniversary flavor. (7) A white and yellow bag of Calbee 4x Thick Cut Potato Chips is displayed. The hand moves slightly to show the textured surface of the bag and the image of thick rippled chips. Subtitles highlight the specific crispiness of this limited edition. (8) The final segment shows a bonus share of Mastic 1Day masks. A hand points to individually packaged masks in slim, elegant tubes in shades of white, pink, and orange. The masks are hung on a display hook in a retail environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens immediately with a high-energy pop beat featuring strong electronic percussion and bright synth pads. A male vocal enters, singing the lyrics 'Lemonade' in an upbeat, modern hip-hop style. The acoustic landscape is very clean, resembling a professionally mixed commercial track with high spectral brightness. (2) The rhythmic loop continues without deviation as the visual cuts between different products. The male singer's voice is processed with a slight melodic autotune effect, characteristic of contemporary pop-rap. There are no sound effects or incidental noises heard, keeping the focus entirely on the driving beat and vocal line. (3) As the video nears its end, the music maintains its intensity and tempo. The harmonic progression remains simple and looped, providing a steady energy for the fast-paced visual reveal of convenience store items. The track ends abruptly at the final frame without a fade-out.

It highlights limited-edition snacks and desserts through quick visual showcases and informative text overlays, appealing to tourists and food enthusiasts.
